description: Issue summary: Customer reports that during a planned weighted rollout with prewarm mirroring, tenant traffic that should have been pinned to the new variant was silently routed back to the legacy variant for a subset of sessions. Impact: ongoing production requests returned mixed model outputs, causing downstream inference quality regressions and a customer-perceived availability blip. Observed billing spike due to duplicated prewarm traffic and repeated fallback attempts.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure a weighted rollout (20% canary) on dedicated capacity in us-west-2. 2) Enable prewarm mirror for the new variant and set route memoization (edge) to enabled with default TTL. 3) Pin a handful of tenant sessions to the canary via API (explicit version pin). 4) Trigger a traffic burst from the customer's traffic simulator and watch routing snapshots. 5) Observe that some pinned sessions are redirected to the legacy variant intermittently and exhibit a rollback loop when the orchestrator attempts to reconcile.
logs:
[2026-03-12T14:02:13Z] edge-proxy: route-memoize: fingerprint=0x7f3a4a TTL=360s USE_CACHE=true route=variant-legacy
[2026-03-12T14:02:14Z] orchestrator: prewarm: mirror-sent tenant=nh-1234 new_variant=redwood/gpt-large-v2
[2026-03-12T14:02:15Z] router: decision=fallback reason=cache-hit stale_snapshot=true pinned_session=true tenant=nh-1234
[2026-03-12T14:02:16Z] reconciler: commit-attempt failed: snapshot-mismatch epoch=452->451
[2026-03-12T14:02:17Z] billing: duplicate-mirror-charge tenant=nh-1234 tokens=12485
hypothesis: Edge memoization cache (route fingerprint memoize) is returning stale routing entries during or immediately after prewarm mirror bursts. The reconciler's snapshot merge path is observing out-of-order epoch updates which causes a transient demotion of the pinned variant in the routing mesh. Prewarm mirror traffic temporarily mutates the snapshot hash used by the memoization layer, creating a TTL window where pinned affinity is not honored.
investigation_notes: Confirmed correlation between prewarm mirror bursts and cache-hit fallback logs
Reconciler traces show epoch regression when prewarm mirror completes in <2s window
Edge memoize key includes mirror metadata; client pins used a different fingerprint namespace than control-plane snapshot
Traffic capture from customer shows repeated dual responses (new + legacy) for same request id
workaround: 1) Temporarily disable prewarm mirroring for the canary variant for Nimbus Health. 2) Increase route memoization TTL to 30m for the tenant to reduce churn while we patch coordination. 3) Add an explicit short-lived edge rule to prefer explicit session pins over memoized entries until reconciler fix is deployed.
resolution_notes: (Pending) Engineering patch queued to change memoization key derivation and add epoch monotonic checks in reconciler merge. Control-plane hotfix PR in review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/1893. Plan: deploy to staging, run Nimbus Health synthetic workload, then promote to canary in us-west-2 within maintenance window.
